title: Book 1 — Clio, Chapter 15
paragraphs: and turn instead to Ardys, the son of Gyges, who became king after him. He took Priene and launched an invasion against Miletus, and while he was ruling at Sardis, the Cimmerians — driven from their homes by the nomad Scythians — came to Asia and captured Sardis, except for the citadel.
